# System Email Surface transparent dark-art fixture

This message tests one transparent PNG containing dark artwork in the existing System Email Surface grammar.

## Review points

- Inspect whether the artwork remains legible in light and dark presentation.
- Confirm the client background behind transparent pixels is acceptable.
- Confirm the caption remains visually connected to the figure.
- Inspect the plain-text alternative and blocked-image behavior.

The paragraph after the figure should remain visually distinct when the message is forwarded, replied to, printed, or exported.
